title: feat: show the buyer's local payment methods by country
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Shows local payment-method logos for the buyer’s country, with PayPal and cards as general examples. Stripe decides what is actually available at checkout.
- Removes the country-by-country PayPal rules; no checkout or payment behavior changes.
- Adds 16 MIT-licensed logos with attribution. Addresses #16004.
- Targeted Enter display tests pass (9/9). Full CI still has the existing quest-leaderboard test failure on main.

gist.headline: A familiar way to pay
gist.blurb: The Pollen payment display gets a local accent: it shows payment-method logos for the buyer’s country alongside familiar PayPal and card examples. Stripe still has the final say at checkout.
gist.summary: Enter adds 16 attributed, MIT-licensed payment-method logos and selects examples by buyer country, replacing country-specific PayPal display rules without changing checkout behavior.
gist.impact: Buyers get more relevant payment-method examples before checkout, while Stripe continues to determine which methods are actually available.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Enter’s Pollen payment display as a cozy counter with a small map and country-specific payment-symbol tiles beside PayPal and card examples. Polli arranges the tiles while a separate checkout terminal hints that the displayed examples are not a promise of availability.
